meta.name: Nomadigit
meta.description: Nomadigit brand tokens: the single source for every site, bot, app, deck, document and image.

rules: Products, bots and apps carry the Nomadigit mark; the product name comes first, Nomadigit second ("Reminder · Nomadigit").
Personal documents (CV, talks, cover letters) lead with "Danil Shubin" and sign off with the signature line.
Never invent sub-brands with their own logos or palettes; a product differs only by its name.

do: Use the mark alone at 16-48px (favicons, avatars, app icons); use the lockup when there is room for the name.
Keep clear space of at least half the mark's height on every side.
On photos or busy backgrounds place the inverse mark on a solid primary chip.
Use the mono variant when only one color is available (embossing, single-color print, system tray).
dont: Don't recolor the route or the waypoint outside the palette, and don't swap their colors.
Don't stretch, rotate, outline, add shadows, gradients or glow.
Don't retype the wordmark in another font; always use the SVG.
Don't place the light mark on mid-tone backgrounds where contrast drops below 3:1.
Don't use the accent red for error states; errors use the darker semantic error color plus an icon and text.

rules: Use Lucide outline icons only; no filled or multicolor icon sets, no emoji as icons.
Icons take the color of the text next to them (currentColor); only status icons use semantic colors.
Pair an icon with a label unless the icon is universally understood (close, search, menu).
Motion confirms an action or shows where something came from; never decorative loops.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: drop movement, keep opacity changes under 120ms.

imagery.style: Flat geometric illustration built from the mark's vocabulary: thick rounded routes, waypoint dots, arcs and grids. Petrol and its scale for shapes, signal red only for one focal point per image, generous empty space.
do: Build images from simple vector shapes in palette colors; one red focal point.
Use real screenshots of the product inside a plain surface frame with the brand radius.
Keep text in images set in Onest and inside the 1200x630 safe area (64px margin).
dont: No stock photos of people at laptops, no 3D blobs, no purple-blue gradients, no neon glow.
No AI-generated photorealism standing in for the product.
No more than two palette colors plus neutrals in one illustration.
imagery.promptTemplate: Flat vector illustration, geometric, thick rounded strokes and dots like a route on a map, color palette deep petrol blue #04556D, light petrol #96DDF9, off-white #F7FBFD, single signal red #FC5950 accent, lots of negative space, no text, no gradients, no shadows, no people. Subject: {{subject}}

principles: Say what happens, then stop. One idea per sentence.
Talk to the reader as "ты" in Russian bots and products, "вы" in formal documents and CV.
Name things the way users call them, not the way the code calls them.
Errors explain what went wrong and what to do next, without apologies.

examples.do: Не понял время. Попробуй «завтра в 10» или «через 30 минут».
Telegram bot that reminds you on time, in your time zone.
